title.en: An Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Operation and Maintenance of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines During the Period From July First, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-two to June Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-three, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Appropriating Additional Funds for the Operation and Maintenance of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines During the Period From July First, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-two to June Thirtieth, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-three, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the period from July first, nineteen hundred and fifty-two to June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and fifty-three, for the purposes specified hereunder:
ORDINARY EXPENDITURES
A.—CONGRESS OF THE PHILIPPINES
(2) HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES I.—Salaries and Wages
1. For other services, including transportation and additional secretarial services for the Members of the House of Representatives or expenses incurred by direction of the Speaker P75,000.00
2. For supplementary force that may be employed at any time in the discretion of the Speaker, including additional compensation for per diems to the military and police attaches of the Speaker P75,000.00 Total for salaries and wages P150,000.00 II.—Sundry Expenses
1. For payment of the cash commutation of the accumulated vacation and/or sick leaves of secretarial and clerical personnel of the Members of the House of Representatives P100,000.00 Total for sundry expenses P100,000.00 Total amount available for the House of Representatives P250,000.00 H-DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND COMMUNICATIONS IV.—Special Purposes
1. For the transportation of foreign airmail, Bureau of Posts P1,500,000.00 Total amount available for the Department of Public Works and Communication P1,500,000.00 I.—DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION IV.—Special Purposes
1. For the operation and maintenance of 3,000 additional public elementary classes including salaries of teachers, salary adjustments for 1950—1951, sundry expenses,purchase of equipment and for the purchase of textbooks, Bureau of Public Schools P6,103,000.00 Total amount available for the Department of Education P6,103,000.00 L.—Department op Health II.—Sundry Expenses
1. Consumption of supplies and materials, Bureau of Hospitals P230,000.00 North General Hospital P100,000.00 National Orthopedic Hospital 100,000.00 National Indigent Children's Hospital 30,000.00 P230,000.00 _____________ Total amount available for the Department of Health P230,000.00 Total amount available for Ordinary Expenditures P8,083,900.00 EXTRAORDINARY EXPENDITURES K.—Department of National Defense Special Purpose
1. For payment of family subsistence allowance to officers and enlisted men of the Armed Forces of the Philippines assigned to overseas duty, authorized in Republic Act No. 815 P1,500,000.00 Total amount available for the Department of National Defense P1,500,000.00 Total amount available for Extraordinary Expenditures P1,500,000.00 GRAND TOTAL OF THE APPROPRIATIONS AUTHORIZED IN THIS ACT: NINE MILLION, FIVE HUNDRED EIGHTY-THREEE THOUSAND, NINE HUNDRED PESOS P9,583,900.00

The provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred and sixteen to the contrary notwithstanding, any savings from the appropriations authorized in the said Act for the Department of Justice and the Department of National Defense may be used to cover the following additional expenses of said departments, respectively, not exceeding the amounts specified hereunder:
F.—Department of Justice
II.—Sundry Expenses
1. Traveling expenses of personnel, Court of Industrial Relations P10,000.00
2. Postal, telegraph, telephone, cable and radio service, Bureau of Immigration 3,700.00
3. Illumination and power service, Bureau of Immigration 2,500.00
4. Rental of buildings and grounds. Bureau of Immigration
100.00
5. Consumption of supplies and materials, Bureau of Immigration 14,000.00
6. Traveling expenses of persons not government employees, including subsistence of alien detainees which in no case shall exceed Pl.50 per day, Bureau of Immigration 27,500.00
7. Maintenance and repair of equipment, Bureau of Immigration
460.00
8. Other services, Bureau of Immigration 1,740.00 Total for sundry expenses P60,000.00 Total amount available for the Department of Justice P60,000.00 K.—Department of National Defense ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES I.—Salaries and Wages
1. For the implementation of the Minimum Wage Law P1,369,005.00 General Headquarters P110,000.00 Philippine Constabulary 160,000.00 Philippine Army 930,005.00 Philippine Air Force 82,000.00 Philippine Navy 87,000.00 P1,369,005.00 ____________ Total amount available for the Department of national Defense P1,369,005.00

The special and general provisions of Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred and sixteen are hereby made applicable to the appropriations provided in this Act: Provided, That no portion of the different items of the appropriations contained in this Act shall be transferred to any other item.

Effective date.—This Act shall take effect as of July first, nineteen hundred and fifty-two.
Approved, June 19, 1953.
